name: Fujikawa Himawari
source:
Weakness: Being tickled. Gets sexual excited when body or hair is lightly touched.

Has excellent grades and is a member of the tennis club where she also excels. She is also a member of the student council and looks to be next in line for student council president.

She has known [url=/c42932]Tsukushi[/url] since childhood, however, she has no romantic interest in him or any man at all because she is a lesbian. Rather, she has strong feelings for his sister, [url=/c42869]Nadeshiko[/url], which she keeps to herself.

One day however, she witnesses Tsukushi and Nadeshiko having sex and misunderstands it as Tsukishi forcing himself on Nadeshiko...

"You already know that I love Onee-sama, so there's no need for me to tell it to others."
